figures.caption: Figure 3: Mean cross-attention weights across 1,000 parallel sentences (content-only filtered). The diagonal band confirms monotonic alignment after attention sink removal; off-diagonal mass reflects the Somali SOV reordering challenge. Each row is a decoder step; each column a source token position.

Figure 2: Comparison of teacher-forcing (TF) and generation similarity scores before and after content-only filtering. The genuine gap between modes more than doubles once attention sink artifacts are removed.
